http_idle_timeout_secs.description: Idle timeout for HTTP keep-alive connections in seconds

handler_stale_timeout_secs.description: Seconds after a handler disconnect before it is reaped from the routing table

attachment_max_bytes.description: Maximum plaintext attachment size in bytes, applied to inbound payloads before spooling and to outbound payloads before encryption

spool_outbound_retention_secs.description: Seconds an abandoned outbound spool entry is retained before the retention sweep deletes it

blob_servers.description: Ordered list of Blossom hosts attachment ciphertext is uploaded to; entries are tried in order until one accepts the blob

mls_archive_retention_days.description: Days to keep an archived legacy MLS store after a reset before it is pruned; 0 (default) deletes the legacy store immediately instead of archiving it. An encrypted store archived because its key was wrong or missing is always kept regardless of this setting.

stuck_bot_warning_min_age_secs.description: Minimum age in seconds a stuck bot or MLS group must reach before the periodic tick warns about it: a group still state-lost, a bot whose MLS engine is still unavailable, or a sole-admin squad still unrepaired.

group_message_rate.description: Per-Squad group-message handler-notification token-bucket refill rate, in tokens per second. Must be greater than 0. Bounds how often a handler is re-notified about ongoing Squad activity, independent of MLS message persistence, which is never rate limited.

group_message_burst.description: Per-Squad group-message handler-notification token-bucket capacity. Must be greater than 0.

id.description: Daemon-local bot identifier. Must be a slug: lowercase letters, digits, hyphens, and underscores only. Maximum 64 characters.

display_name.description: Human-readable display name for the bot profile; used as the @mention alias in squad channels. Must be unique among bots.

about.description: Description text published in the bot's kind:0 profile

picture.description: URL to the bot's profile picture (http:// or https://)

mls_db_path.description: Path to the per-bot MLS SQLite database

mls_key_package_freshness_secs.description: Freshness window in seconds for MLS KeyPackage events

mls_dedup_window_secs.description: Time window in seconds for MLS group-message deduplication
